content: supabase-py/PostgREST applies RLS based on the Authorization Bearer JWT sent per request; service_role bypasses RLS entirely. Official Supabase guidance: keep service_role in a SEPARATE client, never the SSR/user client, because auth calls swap the apikey header for the user JWT. Community consensus (supabase discussion #33811): mutating a shared global client's session/auth token per request is UNSAFE under async concurrency (cross-request token bleed). Recommended: share one httpx.AsyncClient (the real cost is httpx init, not the wrapper) and bind the user JWT per request/per call rather than mutating shared state.
